- That the message has an member: [`type@AtspiError::MissingMember`]

conditions before calling this.

Construct an `ObjectRef` from a `zbus::message::Header`.

# Header fields

`Path` is a mandatory field on method calls and signals,
`Sender` is an optional field, see:
[DBus specification - header fields](<https://dbus.freedesktop.org/doc/dbus-specification.html#message-protocol-header-fields>)).,

```quote
 On a message bus, this header field is controlled by the message bus,
 so it is as reliable and trustworthy as the message bus itself.
 Otherwise, (eg. P2P) this header field is controlled by the message sender,
 unless there is out-of-band information that indicates otherwise.
```

While unlikely, it is possible that `Sender` or `Path` are not set on the header.
This could happen if the server implementation does not set these fields for any reason.

# Errors
Will return an `AtspiError::ParseError` if the header does not contain a valid path or sender.

[`State::Focusable`] or [`State::Selectable`]: Those objects should use
[`State::Focused`] and [`State::Selected`] respectively.

`Active` is a means to indicate that an object which is not
focusable and not selectable is the currently-active item within its
parent container.

2148.name: detail1
2148.docs: Generic detail1 value described by AT-SPI.

1567.name: item
1567.docs: The [`crate::ObjectRef`] which the event applies to.

5.name: Action
5.docs: An action which may be triggered through the accessibility API.

7199.name: ToolBar
7199.docs: A bar or palette usually composed of push buttons or toggle buttons.

7526.name: Sentence
7526.docs: Gives entire sentence in front of, or which contains, the cursor. TODO: confirm that it always chooses the sentence after the cursor.

878.name: ReadOnly
878.docs:
Indicates that an object which is [`State::Enabled`] and
[`State::Sensitive`] has a value which can be read, but not modified, by the
user.

2259.name: Property
2259.docs:
Any accessibility related property on an [`crate::ObjectRef`].
This is used only in the [`PropertyChangeEvent`]; this event gets triggered if a role or accessible
description of an item changes.

4221.name: item
4221.docs: The [`crate::ObjectRef`] which the event applies to.

4875.name: item
4875.docs: The table which has had a column removed.

2005.name: any_data
2005.docs:
Generic `any_data` value described by AT-SPI.
This can be any type.

6183.name: try_from_message
6183.docs:
Convert a [`zbus::Message`] into this event type.
Does all the validation for you.

# Errors

- The message does not have an interface: [`type@AtspiError::MissingInterface`]
- The message interface does not match the one for the event: [`type@AtspiError::InterfaceMatch`]
- The message does not have an member: [`type@AtspiError::MissingMember`]
- The message member does not match the one for the event: [`type@AtspiError::MemberMatch`]
- The message signature does not match the one for the event: [`type@AtspiError::SignatureMatch`]

See [`MessageConversion::from_message_unchecked`] for info on panic condition that should never
happen.

7164.name: Menu
7164.docs: An object usually found inside a menu bar that contains a list of actions the user can choose from.

443.name: PageChangedEvent
443.docs:
The focused page has changed.

This event is usually sent only by document readers, signaling
that the _physical page equivalent is now different.
This event does not encode _which_ page is the new one, only that a new page is now the primary
one.

See `atspi_proxies::document::DocumentProxy::current_page_number` to actively find the
page number.

5275.name: socket
5275.docs: The [`ObjectRef`] for the Registry's root object.

7237.name: InfoBar
7237.docs: An object designed to present a message to the user within an existing window.

843.name: Checked
843.docs: Indicates this object is currently checked.

1316.name: DBusMember
1316.docs:
The `DBus` member for the event.
For example, for an [`crate::events::object::TextChangedEvent`] this should be `"TextChanged"`

7202.name: TreeTable
7202.docs: An object that presents both tabular and hierarchical info to the user.

154.name: Role
154.docs:
An accessible object role.

To think of it in terms of HTML, any semantic element likely has a corollary in this enum.
For example: `<button>`, `<input>`, `<form>` or `<h4>`.
Non-semantic elements like `<span>`, `<div>` and `<b>` will not be represented here, and this information is not passed through via the atspi library.
TODO: add examples for GTK/Qt libraries in addition to HTML examples.

7529.name: Granularity
7529.docs: Level of granularity to get text of, in relation to a cursor position.

1789.name: item
1789.docs: The [`crate::ObjectRef`] which the event applies to.

5205.name: item
5205.docs: The object on which the caret has been moved on.

7167.name: OptionPane
7167.docs: A specialized pane whose primary use is inside a dialog.

7240.name: BlockQuote
7240.docs: An object which contains a text section that is quoted from another source.

846.name: Editable
846.docs: Indicates the user can change the contents of this object.

6332.name: item
6332.docs: The application which has been minimized.

7313.name: Null
7313.docs: Not a meaningful relationship; clients should not normally encounter this value.

1319.name: DBusInterface
1319.docs:
The `DBus` interface name for an event - or a wrapper type.
For example, for any event within the "Object" interface, this should be "org.a11y.atspi.Event.Object".

6805.name: item
6805.docs: The [`crate::ObjectRef`] which the event applies to.

7132.name: AcceleratorLabel
7132.docs: Object is a label indicating the keyboard accelerators for the parent.

7205.name: Window
7205.docs: A top level window with no title or border.

157.name: InterfaceSet
157.docs: A collection type which encodes the AT-SPI interfaces an accessible object has implemented.

1938.name: kind
1938.docs:
kind variant, used for specifying an event triple "object:state-changed:focused",
the "focus" part of this event is what is contained within the kind.

5208.name: position
5208.docs:
New position of the caret.
NOTE: this provide the Unicode index (not the byte index) and therefore when referencing
locations in a string, you should be using the [`std::str::Chars`] iterator, and not use
anything like [`str::get`] (as this uses the byte index).

See also: [`TextChangedEvent`].

6189.name: validate_body
6189.docs:
Validate the body signature against the [`zvariant::Signature`] of [`MessageConversion::Body`]

# Errors

- [`type@AtspiError::SignatureMatch`] if the signatures do not match

7170.name: Panel
7170.docs: A generic container that is often used to group objects.

449.name: BoundsChangedEvent
449.docs:
An event triggered when the visual bounds for an item have changed.
This usually happens either:

1. due to a re-draw on a window whose size has changed and dynamically adjusted said item's visual size, or
2. content within the bounds of said item has changed to change its size.

7243.name: Definition
7243.docs: A definition of a term or concept.

7570.name: Canvas
7570.docs:
The 'background' layer for most content renderers and
UI `atspi_proxies::component::ComponentProxy` containers.

849.name: Expandable
849.docs:
Indicates this object allows progressive
disclosure of its children.

7316.name: NodeChildOf
7316.docs: Object is a child of the target.

1322.name: DBusMatchRule

7208.name: Footer
7208.docs: An object that serves as a document footer.

2195.name: as_owned
2195.docs:
Non-consuming conversion to an owned event body.

Does cloning.

# Errors
The borrowed variant will error if the following conditions are met:  
1. the `any_data` field contains an [`std::os::fd::OwnedFd`] type, and  
2. the maximum number of open files for the process is exceeded.

6046.name: DBUS_INTERFACE
6046.docs:
A static interface string for `DBus`.
This should usually be a string that looks like this: `"org.a11y.atspi.Event.*"`;

1941.name: any_data
1941.docs:
Generic `any_data` value described by AT-SPI.
This can be any type.

7173.name: ProgressBar
7173.docs: An object used to indicate how much of a task has been completed.

7246.name: Log
7246.docs:
A text widget or container holding log content, such as chat history and error logs. In this role there is a relationship between the arrival of new items in the log and the reading order.
The log contains a meaningful sequence and new information is added only to the end of the log, not at arbitrary points.

7573.name: Popup
7573.docs: A layer for popup window content, above [`Layer::Widget`].

852.name: Horizontal
852.docs: Indicates the orientation of this object is horizontal.

7319.name: FlowsTo
7319.docs:
Object renders content which flows logically to another object.
For instance, text in a paragraph may flow to another object
which is not the 'next sibling' in the accessibility hierarchy.

1325.name: RegistryEventString
1325.docs: A static `Registry` event string for registering with the `RegistryProxy` for receiving events.

7138.name: CheckBox
7138.docs: A choice that can be checked or unchecked and provides a separate indicator for the current state.

7211.name: Application
7211.docs:
An object corresponding to the toplevel accessible of an application, which may contain [`Self::Frame`] objects or other accessible objects.
Children of objects with the [`Self::DesktopFrame`] role are generally [`Self::Application`] objects.

163.name: ObjectMatchRuleBuilder
163.docs:
The 'builder' type for `MatchRule`.
Use its methods to set match criteria.

2198.name: take_kind
2198.docs:
Take or convert the `kind` field as `String`.

With the owned variant, this method takes the `kind` field and replaces it with an empty string.
With the borrowed variant, this method clones and allocates the `kind` field.

3833.name: Name
3833.docs: Name of the element; this can either be the text of a simple UI element like a [`crate::Role::Button`], but it could also be alternative text via [`aria-label`](https://www.w3.org/TR/wai-aria/#aria-label).

963.name: iter
963.docs: Returns an iterator that yields each set [`State`].

7176.name: RootPane
7176.docs: A specialized pane that has a glass pane and a layered pane as its children.

455.name: VisibleDataChangedEvent
455.docs: A change in whether a particular item is visible or invisible (but still present).

7249.name: Rating
7249.docs:
A rating system, generally out of five stars, but it does not need to be that way. There is no tag nor role for this in HTML, however.
A widget whose purpose is to display a rating, such as the number of stars associated with a song in a media player.
Objects of this role should also implement [`crate::Interface::Value`].

7576.name: Layer
7576.docs:
Indicates relative stacking order of a `atspi_proxies::component::ComponentProxy` with respect to the
onscreen visual representation of the UI.

The layer index, in combination with the component's extents,
can be used to compute the visibility of all or part of a component.
This is important in programmatic determination of region-of-interest for magnification,
and in flat screen review models of the screen, as well as for other uses.
Objects residing in two of the `Layer` categories support further z-ordering information,
with respect to their peers in the same layer:
namely, [`Layer::Window`] and [`Layer::Mdi`].
Relative stacking order for other objects within the same layer is not available;
the recommended heuristic is first child paints first. In other words,
assume that the first siblings in the child list are subject to being
overpainted by later siblings if their bounds intersect.

855.name: MultiLine
855.docs:
Indicates this (text) object can contain multiple
lines of text.

7322.name: Embeds
7322.docs: Similar to `SubwindowOf`, but specifically used for cross-process embedding.

347.name: new_owned

7141.name: ColumnHeader
7141.docs: The header for a column of data.

7214.name: Embedded
7214.docs:
The object is an embedded component container.
This role is a "grouping" hint that the contained objects share a context which is different from the container in which this accessible is embedded.
In particular, it is used for some kinds of document embedding, and for embedding of out-of-process component, "panel applets", etc.

5652.name: item

6633.name: item
6633.docs: A reference to the destroyed desktop.

7614.name: BottomRight
7614.docs: Scroll the object to the bottom right corner of the window.

4417.name: item
4417.docs: The [`crate::ObjectRef`] which the event applies to.

2201.name: any_data
2201.docs:
The `any_data` field as `&Value`.
With both variants, this method returns a reference to the `any_data` field.

1039.name: index
1039.docs: The accessbile index in parent.  i

7179.name: ScrollPane
7179.docs:
A scroll pane: the pane in which the scrollable content is contained within.
An object that allows a user to incrementally view a large amount of information.
[`Self::ScrollPane`] objects are usually accompanied by [`Self::ScrollBar`] controllers,
on which the [`crate::RelationType::ControllerFor`] and [`crate::RelationType::ControlledBy`] reciprocal relations are set.

458.name: SelectionChangedEvent
458.docs:
The selection of this item has changed.
For example: when a selection from a series of checkboxes is changed, this will change the state of the child, _and_ cause a [`SelectionChangedEvent`] on the parent.

7252.name: MathRoot
7252.docs: An object that represents a mathematical expression displayed with a radical.

858.name: Pressed
858.docs: Indicates this object is currently pressed.

7325.name: ParentWindowOf
7325.docs: This is the reciprocal relation to `PopupFor`.

350.name: try_from_bus_name_and_path
350.docs:
Create a new `ObjectRef`, from `BusName` and `ObjectPath`.

# Errors
Will fail if the `sender` is not a `UniqueName`.

7144.name: DesktopFrame
7144.docs: A pane that supports internal frames and iconified versions of those internal frames.

7217.name: DocumentFrame
7217.docs:
The object is a visual frame or container which
contains a view of document content. [`Self::DocumentFrame`]s may occur within
another `DocumentProxy` instance, in which case the second  document may be
said to be embedded in the containing instance.
HTML frames are often [`Self::DocumentFrame`]:  Either this object, or a singleton descendant,
should implement the [`crate::Interface::Document`] interface.

496.name: AvailableEvent
496.docs:
An event that is emitted when the registry daemon has started.

The accessibility registry emits this signal early during startup,
when it has registered with the `DBus` daemon and is available for
calls from applications.

1150.name: InterfaceMatch
1150.docs: On specific types, if the event / message member does not match the Event's name.

7617.name: LeftEdge
7617.docs: Scroll the object to the left edge of the window.

569.name: is_null
569.docs: Returns `true` if the object reference is `Null`, otherwise returns `false`.

4420.name: Politeness
4420.docs:
Enumeration used to indicate a type of live region and how assertive it
should be in terms of speaking notifications.

Currently, this is only used
for `Announcement` events, but it may be used for additional purposes
in the future.
The argument in the `Announcement` event is named `politeness`.

5074.name: length
5074.docs:
length of the insertion/deletion

NOTE: This gives the unicode length (not the byte length).

3839.name: Parent
3839.docs: Parent of the item in a hierarchical tree.

7182.name: Separator
7182.docs: An object usually contained in a menu to provide a visible and logical separation of the contents in a menu.

461.name: ModelChangedEvent
461.docs:
An event sent when the method of selecting items in a list/set of options changes.
Also see: <https://docs.gtk.org/gtk4//method.GridView.set_model.html>

2096.name: detail2
2096.docs: Generic detail2 value described by AT-SPI.

7255.name: DescriptionTerm
7255.docs: An object that represents a term or phrase with a corresponding definition.

861.name: Showing
861.docs:
Indicates this object, the object's parent, the
object's parent's parent, and so on, are all 'shown' to the end-user,
i.e. subject to "exposure" if blocking or obscuring objects do not
interpose between this object and the top of the window stack.

7328.name: ErrorMessage
7328.docs:
Reciprocal of `ErrorFor`.
Indicates that this object has one or more errors, the nature of which is
described in the contents of the target object(s). Objects that have this
relation type should also contain [`crate::state::State::InvalidEntry`] when their
`GetState` method is called.

Included in upstream [AT-SPI2-CORE](https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/at-spi2-core) since 2.26.

1261.name: node_added
1261.docs: A cache item to add to the internal cache.

353.name: from_static_str_unchecked
353.docs:
Create a new `ObjectRef`, unchecked.

# Safety
The caller must ensure that the strings are valid.

7147.name: Dialog
7147.docs: A top level window with title bar and a border.

99.name: Inorder
99.docs: Traverse the tree in order of appearance.

7220.name: Section
7220.docs:
The object is a containing instance of document content which constitutes a particular 'logical' section of the document.
The type of content within a section, and the nature of the section division itself, may be obtained by querying the object's attributes.
Sections may be nested.

4023.name: enabled
4023.docs: Whether the state was enabled or disabled.

499.name: LineChangedEvent
499.docs: A line of text has been changed.

7620.name: ScrollType
7620.docs: Enumeration used by interface the [`crate::interface::Interface::Accessible`] to specify where an object should be placed on the screen when using `scroll_to`.

572.name: path

1553.name: EventBody
1553.docs:
Common event body that can be either owned or borrowed.

This is useful for APIs that can return either owned or borrowed event bodies.
Having this type allows to be generic over the event body type.

1045.name: states
1045.docs: The states applicable to the accessible.  au

7185.name: SplitPane
7185.docs: A specialized panel that presents two other panels at the same time.

464.name: AttributesChangedEvent
464.docs:
Signal that some attribute of an object (usually styling) has changed.
This event does not encode _what_ has changed about the attributes, merely that they have
changed.

To query the updated information, use `atspi_proxies::AccessibleProxy`'s `get_attribute` method.

2099.name: to_fully_owned
2099.docs:
Convert this borrowed event body to an owned event body.

# Errors

This will error if the following conditions are met:
1. the `any_data` field contains an [`std::os::fd::OwnedFd`] type, and
2. the maximum number of open files for the process is exceeded.

Chances are slim because none of the types in [`crate::events`] use [`std::os::fd::OwnedFd`].
See [`zvariant::Value::try_clone`] for more information.

7258.name: Footnote
7258.docs: An object that contains the text of a footnote.

864.name: Stale
864.docs:
Indicates that the information returned for this object
may no longer be synchronized with the application state.  This can occur
if the object has [`State::Transient`], and can also occur towards the
end of the object peer's lifecycle.

7658.name: Polite
7658.docs: This live region should be considered polite.

7150.name: FileChooser
7150.docs: A specialized dialog that displays the files in the directory and lets the user select a file, browse a different directory, or specify a filename.

7223.name: Link
7223.docs:
The object is a hypertext anchor, i.e. a "link" in a hypertext document.
Such objects are distinct from 'inline' content which may also use the [`crate::Interface::Hypertext`]/[`crate::Interface::Hyperlink`] interfaces to indicate the range/location within a text object where an inline or embedded object lies.

502.name: ColumnCountChangedEvent
502.docs:
The width of a terminal emulator has changed sufficiently such that the number of characters
able to fit on one *visual* line has changed.

4680.name: item
4680.docs: The table which has had a row removed.

1156.name: SignatureMatch
1156.docs: To indicate a match or equality test on a signal body signature failed.

248.name: All
248.docs: All of the criteria must be met.

6461.name: item
6461.docs: The application which has been closed.

7442.name: Window
7442.docs: In relation to only the window.

7188.name: TableCell
7188.docs:
A 'cell' or discrete child within a Table.
Note: Table cells need not have [`Self::TableCell`], other [`crate::Role`] values are valid as well.

467.name: RowInsertedEvent
467.docs: A row has been added to a table.

6934.name: item
6934.docs: The application which has been resized.

7261.name: Details
7261.docs:
Reciprocal of `DetailsFor`.
Indicates that this object has a detailed or extended description,
the contents of which can be found in the target object(s).
This relation type is most appropriate for information that is sufficiently lengthy
as to make navigation to the container of that information desirable.
For less verbose information suitable for announcement only, see `DescribedBy`.
If the detailed information describes an error condition, `ErrorFor` should be used instead.
Included in upstream [AT-SPI2-CORE](https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/at-spi2-core) since 2.26.

867.name: ManagesDescendants
867.docs:
Indicates that "active-descendant-changed"
event is sent when children become 'active' (i.e. are selected or
navigated to onscreen).  Used to prevent need to enumerate all children
in very large containers, like tables. The presence of
`ManagesDescendants` is an indication to the client that the
children should not, and need not, be enumerated by the client.
Objects implementing this state are expected to provide relevant state
notifications to listening clients, for instance notifications of
visibility changes and activation of their contained child objects, without
the client having previously requested references to those children.

32.name: into
32.docs: Calls `U::from(self)`. That is, this conversion is whatever the implementation of [From]<T> for U chooses to do.

359.name: name_as_str
359.docs: Returns the name of the object reference as a string slice.

7153.name: FontChooser
7153.docs: Allows selection of a display font.

3956.name: item
3956.docs: The [`crate::ObjectRef`] which the event applies to.

7226.name: TreeItem
7226.docs: An object that represents an element of a tree.

505.name: LineCountChangedEvent
505.docs:
The height of a terminal emulator has changed sufficiently such that the number of lines
able to fit within the terminal has changed.

251.name: Empty
251.docs:
Same as [`Self::All`] if the criterion item is non-empty - All of the criteria must be met.
For empty criteria this rule requires the returned value to also have empty set.

3848.name: TableRowDescription
3848.docs:
Similar to [`Self::TableRowHeader`] except it's the attached description instead of the
data in the header.

397.name: deserialize
397.docs:
`ObjectRef`'s wire format is `(&str, ObjectPath)`.
An empty `&str` with a "/org/a11y/atspi/null" path is considered a `Null` object,
this is deserialized as `ObjectRef::Null`.\
Any other valid `(&str, ObjectPath)`  will deserialize into `ObjectRef::Borrowed`.

7191.name: LabelledBy
7191.docs: Object is labelled by one or more other objects.

470.name: RowReorderedEvent
470.docs: A row has been moved within a table.

7264.name: Suggestion
7264.docs:
A container for content that is called out as a proposed change from the current version of the document, such as by a reviewer of the content.
An object with this role should include children with [`Self::ContentDeletion`] and/or [`Self::ContentInsertion`], in any order, to indicate what the actual change is.

870.name: Animated
870.docs:
Indicates this object's visual representation is
dynamic, not static. This state may be applied to an object during an
animated 'effect' and be removed from the object once its visual
representation becomes static. Some applications, notably content viewers,
may not be able to detect all kinds of animated content.  Therefore the
absence of this state should not be taken as
definitive evidence that the object's visual representation is
static; this state is advisory.

5521.name: registry
5521.docs:
This module contains the events that are emitted by the registry daemon.
The events are [`EventListenerRegisteredEvent`] and [`EventListenerDeregisteredEvent`].

7156.name: HTMLContainer
7156.docs: A document container for HTML, whose children represent the document content.

7483.name: Max
7483.docs: Characters/glyphs which intersect the maximum coordinate are omitted.

4286.name: item
4286.docs: The [`crate::ObjectRef`] which the event applies to.

1089.name: AddAccessibleEvent
1089.docs:
Type that contains the `zbus::Message` for meta information and
the [`crate::cache::CacheItem`]

4940.name: item
4940.docs: The [`crate::ObjectRef`] which the event applies to.

2070.name: StateChangedEvent
2070.docs:
A state of an object has been modified.
A [`State`] can be added or removed from any [`crate::ObjectRef`].

7229.name: DocumentText
7229.docs: A document frame which contains textual content, such as found in a word processing application.

835.name: Invalid
835.docs: Indicates an invalid state - probably an error condition.

1162.name: UnknownRole
1162.docs: When matching on an unknown role

5340.name: socket
5340.docs: This module contains the event that is emitted by the registry daemon's `Socket` interface.
